title: Dreams Lab
question: Choose how you want to define, watch and compare an experiment. Each preview uses the same illustrative delivery task.

options.label: A · Workspace
options.thesis: Keep the world in view while you adjust the experiment.
options.viewport: A compact brief at left, a large world in the middle and agent activity below.
options.risk: Detailed setup and run comparisons need a second view.

options.label: B · Notebook
options.thesis: Make the hypothesis, environment and result one readable experiment.
options.viewport: A study outline beside a continuous brief, world preview and outcome.
options.risk: Less space for watching several agents at once.

options.label: C · Compare
options.thesis: Put the changed parameter and its consequences next to each other.
options.viewport: Two environments share a timeline above a compact results comparison.
options.risk: A first experiment takes more setup than in Workspace or Notebook.
